purpose: Assess leakage out of the computational subspace and QFI change for declared effective multilevel emitter spectra.

units.gd: existing normalized additive DCE coefficient, dimensionless

model_note: Each platform is an effective spectrum with the shared dipole-like ladder operator sum_e sqrt(e+1)(|e><e+1|+|e+1><e|); the models differ only in the declared level spacings. Effective spectra are not full circuit simulations.

solver.name: qutip.sesolve for kappa_rel=0; qutip.mesolve otherwise
solver.collapse_note: Loss rows add sqrt(kappa) a, declared zero-temperature emitter relaxation sqrt(gamma1) b, and number-like dephasing; gamma1/wc=1e-6 and gamma_phi/wc=3e-5.

validation.numerical_physicality_note: Trace/Hermiticity/eigenvalue acceptance is not a proof of exact positivity.
validation.leakage_tolerance_note: The adequacy criterion (max leakage <= tolerance over the window) is a declared model choice, not a universal validity condition.

caveats: Effective spectra are model proxies with shared ladder matrix elements; they are not device simulations.
Adequacy is reported for the explicitly parameterized model and finite drive window only.
No universal two-level validity, definitive platform choice, universal anharmonicity requirement, or measured flux-noise limit is inferred.
The time-dependent effective USC Hamiltonian retains the manuscript gauge/control caveat.
